heading: Monday, March 17, 2025
topLine: Mistral releases Mistral Small 3.1 with image understanding.

items.headline: Mistral releases Mistral Small 3.1 with image understanding
items.summary: Mistral Small 3.1 adds multimodal image understanding and a 128k-token context to the 24B Small line and is released under Apache 2.0. Mistral claims it outperforms Gemma 3 and GPT-4o Mini while running at about 150 tokens per second on a single RTX 4090-class GPU.
